## Weighted Prediction Error

People update beliefs using *prediction error*

::: {.fragment}
$$V_n = V_{n-1} + \textcolor{#d62728}{\frac{\alpha_0}{n^{\lambda}}} (V_{n-1} - I_n)$$
:::

::: {.fragment}
::: {.image-card}
![](images/wpe.svg){style="height: 200px; width: auto;"}
:::
:::
